name: Account Management
implementation: Departmental OIDC IdP; cluster roles bound to IdP groups; kubeadmin and self-provisioning removed
automated_check: ACM itsg33-ia-2-kubeadmin-removed, itsg33-ac-6-no-self-provisioning; Compliance Operator rules annotated AC-2

name: Access Enforcement
implementation: RBAC, restricted-v2 SCC, Pod Security admission, ValidatingAdmissionPolicy for tenant namespaces

name: Information Flow Enforcement
implementation: BANP default deny between tenants; ANP guardrails; project template network policies
automated_check: Compliance Operator rules annotated AC-4; RHACS network graph

name: Least Privilege
implementation: Minimal cluster-admin bindings (IdP group and Argo CD controller, AD-22); read-only auditor group

name: System Use Notification
implementation: OAuth login template, console banner, oc login message
automated_check: ACM itsg33-ac-8-login-banner; Compliance Operator rules annotated AC-8

name: Session Termination
implementation: OAuth token inactivity 15 minutes and maximum age 8 hours
automated_check: Compliance Operator rules annotated AC-12 (tailored value 15m0s)

name: Audit Events
implementation: API audit profile WriteRequestBodies plus AllRequestBodies for human users
automated_check: ACM itsg33-au-2-audit-profile; Compliance Operator rules annotated AU-2

name: Audit Storage Capacity
implementation: Audit and infrastructure logs forwarded to the departmental SIEM over mutual TLS

name: Protection of Audit Information
implementation: Logs leave the cluster to the SIEM; restricted access to logging namespaces; LokiStack 30 days

name: Plan of Action and Milestones
implementation: POA&M fed by scan results and policy status

name: Continuous Monitoring
implementation: Daily Compliance Operator scans; ACM inform policies; RHACS; File Integrity Operator

name: Baseline Configuration
implementation: All platform configuration in Git and applied by Argo CD
automated_check: Argo CD sync status; Compliance Operator

name: Configuration Change Control
implementation: Pull requests with review; change tickets; manual install plan approval

name: Least Functionality
implementation: Default operator catalogs disabled; allowed registries only

name: Information System Backup
implementation: OADP nightly tenant backups to departmental S3; etcd backups

name: Identification and Authentication
implementation: Departmental OIDC IdP with MFA at the IdP; no local accounts

name: Vulnerability Scanning
implementation: RHACS in offline mode; vulnerability data imported at least daily

name: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
implementation: TLS 1.2+ AES-GCM profiles on API server, ingress and kubelets; IPsec east-west

name: Cryptographic Protection
implementation: FIPS mode set at installation; FIPS-approved cipher suites only

name: Protection of Information at Rest
implementation: etcd encryption aesgcm; LUKS2 on boot disks bound to TPM 2.0; encrypted storage array

name: Flaw Remediation
implementation: Monthly content imports; z-stream upgrades through OpenShift Update Service; operator updates by approved install plan

name: Software and Information Integrity
implementation: File Integrity Operator (AIDE) on every node; signed transfers
